summary: Dense residential kerb with homes within 1-6 m along the whole stretch.
reasons: Houses and apartments line this side
Cars park here but neighbours would notice

best_section.where: North kerb of Cunningham Street, mid-block between the two cross streets

drivers.seclusion: Apartments at 2 m, houses at 6 m and 1 m line the north side; homes also across the road at 15-20 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Cars park along the kerb so a van can pull in, but there is no gap clear of dwellings.
drivers.traffic: Residential street, light traffic, busy road at the east end.
drivers.convention: Kerb parking is normal, but residents are directly adjacent.

flags: Dwellings within 10 m of the whole stretch
Weekday daytime no-parking signs (7am-6pm); overnight not restricted by them
sun_shade: Mostly open; building shade from the north in the morning, trees near 50 m.
